title: Sigma Investment Counselors Inc. Purchases 2,651 Shares of Apple Inc. (AAPL)

organizations.name: capital investment services of america inc.

text:
Sigma Investment Counselors Inc. increased its position in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 6.8% in the third quarter, according to its most recent 13F filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC). The fund owned 41,573 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after buying an additional 2,651 shares during the quarter. Apple accounts for 1.2% of Sigma Investment Counselors Inc.’s portfolio, making the stock its 15th largest position. Sigma Investment Counselors Inc.’s holdings in Apple were worth $9,385,000 at the end of the most recent quarter.
A number of other large investors have also recently added to or reduced their stakes in the stock. Gibraltar Capital Management Inc. increased its stake in shares of Apple by 0.4% during the third quarter. Gibraltar Capital Management Inc. now owns 59,517 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $13,435,000 after buying an additional 235 shares during the period. Capital Investment Services of America Inc. increased its stake in shares of Apple by 10.0% during the third quarter. Capital Investment Services of America Inc. now owns 2,703 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $610,000 after buying an additional 245 shares during the period. Anderson Hoagland & Co. increased its stake in shares of Apple by 1.3% during the third quarter. Anderson Hoagland & Co. now owns 19,900 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $4,551,000 after buying an additional 250 shares during the period. MinichMacGregor Wealth Management LLC increased its stake in shares of Apple by 13.5% during the third quarter. MinichMacGregor Wealth Management LLC now owns 2,168 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $492,000 after buying an additional 258 shares during the period. Finally, Investment Partners LTD. increased its stake in shares of Apple by 4.9% during the second quarter. Investment Partners LTD. now owns 5,594 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $1,036,000 after buying an additional 263 shares during the period. Institutional investors own 57.02% of the company’s stock. Get Apple alerts:
Several equities research analysts recently weighed in on AAPL shares. Nomura reaffirmed a “neutral” rating and issued a $185.00 price target on shares of Apple in a research note on Monday, November 5th. UBS Group upped their price target on Apple from $180.00 to $185.00 in a research note on Wednesday. JPMorgan Chase & Co. set a $228.00 price target on Apple and gave the stock a “buy” rating in a research note on Wednesday. Monness Crespi & Hardt upped their price target on Apple from $200.00 to $220.00 and gave the stock a “buy” rating in a research note on Wednesday. Finally, Canaccord Genuity reduced their price target on Apple from $190.00 to $185.00 and set a “buy” rating on the stock in a research note on Wednesday. Three equities research analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, twenty-four have assigned a hold rating and twenty-two have issued a buy rating to the company. The stock presently has an average rating of “Hold” and a consensus target price of $192.90.
Apple stock opened at $165.25 on Thursday. The company has a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.87, a quick ratio of 1.09 and a current ratio of 1.12. Apple Inc. has a 12 month low of $142.00 and a 12 month high of $233.47. The firm has a market capitalization of $760.27 billion, a price-to-earnings ratio of 13.87, a P/E/G ratio of 1.49 and a beta of 1.23.
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last released its earnings results on Tuesday, January 29th. The iPhone maker reported $4.18 EPS for the quarter, topping the Thomson Reuters’ consensus estimate of $4.17 by $0.01. Apple had a return on equity of 51.09% and a net margin of 22.72%. The business had revenue of $84.31 billion for the quarter, compared to the consensus estimate of $84.07 billion. On average, research analysts predict that Apple Inc. will post 11.89 EPS for the current year.
The business also recently announced a quarterly dividend, which will be paid on Thursday, February 14th. Shareholders of record on Monday, February 11th will be issued a $0.73 dividend. This represents a $2.92 annualized dividend and a yield of 1.77%. Apple’s dividend payout ratio (DPR) is 24.52%.
In other news, insider Chris Kondo sold 3,408 shares of the company’s stock in a transaction on Monday, November 19th. The stock was sold at an average price of $190.00, for a total transaction of $647,520.00. Following the transaction, the insider now directly owns 8,940 shares of the company’s stock, valued at $1,698,600. The sale was disclosed in a filing with the SEC, which is available at the SEC website . Corporate insiders own 0.05% of the company’s stock.

Apple Profile
Apple Inc designs, manufactures, and markets mobile communication and media devices, and personal computers. It also sells various related software, services, accessories, and third-party digital content and applications. The company offers iPhone, a line of smartphones; iPad, a line of multi-purpose tablets; and Mac, a line of desktop and portable personal computers, as well as iOS, macOS, watchOS, and tvOS operating systems.
